name: MarkItDown
description: Converts PDF, Office, HTML, image, audio, and ZIP files into structured Markdown for LLM pipelines, preserving headings, lists, tables, and links.

skills.name: Office Document Conversion
skills.description: Converts PDF, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, EPUB, and HTML files to Markdown while preserving headings, lists, tables, and links.

skills.name: Image And Audio Extraction
skills.description: Reads EXIF metadata from images, runs OCR on them, and transcribes speech from WAV and MP3 audio files into Markdown.

skills.name: MCP URI Conversion
skills.description: Serves a convert_to_markdown tool over STDIO, Streamable HTTP, or SSE that accepts http, https, file, and data URIs.

skills.name: Azure Cloud Extraction
skills.description: Routes conversion through Azure Document Intelligence or Content Understanding for cloud OCR, layout analysis, and field extraction.

skills.name: Third Party Plugins
skills.description: Loads third-party converter plugins with --use-plugins and lists installed ones, including LLM-vision OCR from markitdown-ocr.
